name: mirage
text: Thanks, that's the second report. The start time is now 4.5 s, down from 15 s on the first run after install. That's much better, but still more than I want, and I'll keep cutting. Two things are still wrong. First, the +EV tab freezes (worst frame 3.0 s, 8 frozen frames in total) and Settings is also slow, and 25% of frames are slow while idle. Second, bets.json is still 8 MB and rewritten whole. Those are my next two fixes (PF11). The ParlayAPI key ending 10d2 is still refused, and parlay-api.com is answering slowly (36 KB/s). Notifications are still off, which you have to turn on in Android Settings.
